skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand relevant terminologies related to accounting data, accounting information, accounting database, accounting software, accounting information system, process handling accounting tasks, developing accounting information systems.

Explain the content of digitalizing accounting management, accounting information systems, and the role of accounting information systems in business organizations, especially in today's digital economy.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Deployment of Accounting Information System Development Process
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Deploy stages of the development process of accounting information systems: deploying data warehouse systems, deploying tools for creating accounting databases, programming tools for accounting software.

Proficiently use MS Access to build basic accounting subsystems in accounting software for small and medium-sized businesses. Analyze real-world problems at businesses to advise on choosing the most suitable and optimal accounting software.
Evaluate the quality and effectiveness of various accounting software available in the market.

Develop analytical skills for planning, implementing digital transformation, and developing smart businesses. Evaluate the quality and effectiveness of various accounting software available in the market.
Proficiently use MS Access to implement practical accounting software at organizations/businesses.

Possess self-learning abilities, reading materials about accounting informatics and accounting information systems, systematic thinking, and modeling in approaching and solving accounting problems of businesses.
Possess the ability to work independently or actively, positively, and effectively participate in group activities. Possess organizational skills for group activities.
Have social responsibility and professional ethics in the field of information management systems.
